issues: 左上卡里叠了一块白底 KPI 数字块（1,284 + 灰条），在新 dashboard 上正好盖住 Active users 卡的曲线，像贴上去的补丁
没有导出时长常量，工作台从源码抓到 45f，第三格扩张与摘罩后的特写都没渲染出来
三格机位一格对中上卡、一格对左上浮块，不是同一主体的层层逼近；摘罩后的满屏特写里还露着半截侧栏
未弹入的区域是纯白死区，缝线是平面双线，分格没有纸面层次
定格期微推是线性的，扩张段 650px/12f 的高速横移没有任何运动模糊
changes: 删除浮在卡上的 KPI 白块，数字特写直接对准页面自身的 Active users 指标 "24,812 ↗+12.4%"，三格全部对准同一张卡：全景 1x / 曲线特写 1.9x / 指标特写 2.6x
补 COMIC_PANEL_SPLIT_DURATION = 150；分格 20f、2f 错峰、3f 弹入、18f 定格、12f out-cubic 扩张、57f 摘罩全部不变
机位改为"焦点 F 落到屏幕 C"参数化，扩张时 F/C 同步插值到满屏终点（焦点 x=590，2.6x 视口左缘恰好避开侧栏）；摘罩帧改 CSS zoom 栅格化，字边锐利
纸面改暖白 #f3f2ee + 颗粒；斜缝在 16px 墨线 + 10px 白核下垫一层 7px 高斯柔影，像印在纸上的格子；弹入脉冲改带色相的深色
定格微推改 in-out（扩张起点速度归零）；扩张段第三格内容与移动缝线按速度挂横向 SpeedBlur
issuesEn: A white KPI block (1,284 plus a grey bar) was stacked on the top-left card and, on the new dashboard, covered the Active users chart like a pasted patch
No exported duration; the workbench grabbed 45f from the source, so the third panel's expansion and the final close-up never rendered
Panel cameras pointed at the top-middle card and the floating block rather than pushing in on one subject, and the full-screen close-up showed half a sidebar
Areas not yet popped in were dead white, the gutters were flat double lines, and the panels had no printed-page depth
The hold-phase push was linear, and the 650px-in-12f expansion had no motion blur
changesEn: Removed the floating KPI block; the digit close-up now frames the page's own Active users metric '24,812 ↗+12.4%', and all three panels frame that one card: wide 1x / chart 1.9x / metric 2.6x
Added COMIC_PANEL_SPLIT_DURATION = 150; split at 20f, 2f stagger, 3f pop, 18f hold, 12f out-cubic expansion and the frame-57 unmask all unchanged

Cameras are now parameterised as 'focus F lands at screen point C', and during expansion F and C interpolate together to the full-screen end (focus x=590, so the 2.6x view's left edge clears the sidebar); the unmasked frame uses CSS zoom so text stays sharp
Paper is now warm white #f3f2ee with grain; each slanted gutter (16px ink + 10px white core) sits on a 7px Gaussian soft shadow so the panels read as printed; the pop pulse uses a tinted dark
The hold push is now in-out (zero velocity when expansion starts); during expansion the third panel's content and the moving gutter get velocity-based horizontal SpeedBlur
